title: Herschel Walker workout (5000 pushups/sit ups a day routine)
summary: Review of Herschel Walker's famous daily bodyweight routine (5000 push-ups, 3000 sit-ups, 1500 pull-ups, 1000 dips, 1000 squats). The transcript is unusable, so this note comes from the description: NH calls the routine unrealistic and a waste of effort for nearly everyone, both because of the time it takes and its poor fatigue-to-stimulus ratio.
claims: Herschel Walker reportedly did 5000 push-ups, 3000 sit-ups, 1500 pull-ups, 1000 dips and 1000 squats every day
Huge-volume bodyweight routines like Walker's are unrealistic and a waste of effort for 99% of people
Beyond the time commitment, such routines have a poor fatigue-to-stimulus ratio for hypertrophy
exercises: criticised as part of an extreme-volume routine with poor stimulus-to-fatigue
